text:
zoe: Quick rally to turn the postmortem into a tight set of owners and deadlines. Keep replies short and claim with "+owner ETA".

zoe: Brief recap: maintenance-related route churn -> one missed cross-region snapshot -> messy partial restore. Recurring exposure: long TTLs during maintenance + manual restore steps that assume full replica parity.

harry: I'll take ownership of the snapshot gap remediation. Plan: 1) small parity checker that runs after each snapshot, 2) one-off backfill runner for missed windows. Ticket: BOARD-2301. Quick demo by 3d, automation in 2w.

emily: I'll own restore ergonomics. Work: add a --simulate flag to the restore CLI, surface precise byte-counts and estimated time, and make partial-restore steps idempotent. PR will include sample output. ETA 10 business days.

kai: Networking lead here. I'll implement a pre-apply BGP stability check and an emergency soft-route toggle for the controller. Also proposing a temporary policy: drop DNS TTL to 30s for maintenance windows. Repo proto: https://git/repo/net/safe-toggle. ETA prototype 1w.

sophie: I'll own observability and alerts. Tasks: new metric for "replica_manifest_mismatch", synthetic nightly restore smoke, and dashboards to show restore ETA vs SLO. ETA panels + alerts 5d.

zoe: Owners shorthand: snapshots=harry, restore-cli=emily, routing=kai, telemetry=sophie. I'll add these to INC-2026-840 and tag owners.

harry: Sample parity check for reviewers (will add to BOARD-2301):

```
# parity check
aws s3 cp s3://backups/region-a/manifest.json - | jq -S . > /tmp/a
ssh eu 'aws s3 cp s3://backups/region-b/manifest.json - | jq -S .' > /tmp/b
diff -u /tmp/a /tmp/b || echo "PARITY_MISMATCH"
```

emily: Example restore --simulate output I'll aim for in the PR:

```
$ redwood-restore --region eu --preview
preview actions:\n - restore 12 objects (1.2GB)
 - expected duration: ~4m
 - estimated cost: $0.03
```

kai: Note: the soft-route toggle must be feature-flagged and require infra signoff. Also, we'll add a quick rollback path to the routing controller. Tagging eng-infra after proto is up.

sophie: I'll add the synthetic to run in staging first and then prod. Alert will fire on manifest mismatch OR nightly-synthetic-fail. I'll link BOARD-2302 for dashboards.

incident-bot: Created INC-2026-840: "DR remediation owners rally" and scheduled a follow-up 2026-04-12T17:00Z.

zoe: Game-day plan suggestion: control-plane dry-run 2026-04-14 (no data movement) and full failover drill 2026-04-21. Who's good for those dates?

harry: 04-14 dry-run OK; will validate parity job beforehand.

emily: 04-21 full drill tentative but should be fine; will ensure CLI simulate mode is ready prior.

kai: Both dates OK; will prioritize the soft-route exercise during full drill.

sophie: available both; will make sure dashboards and alerts are green.

zoe: Please confirm final ETAs in this thread so I can update the action tracker (owner + ETA). I'll close out once cards are created.

harry: snapshots parity + backfill runner -> 2026-04-04. +1

emily: restore --simulate + idempotent partial steps -> 2026-04-13. +1

kai: routing pre-check + soft-route prototype -> 2026-04-07. +1

sophie: telemetry + synthetic -> 2026-04-06. +1

zoe: Thanks everyone. I'll populate INC-2026-840 and BOARD-2301/2302, and send calendar invites for the dry-run and drill. If anything blocks, bump this thread or escalate to the DR rota. :rocket:
